name: warm-close
description: Runs /close conversation --checkpoint shortly before the prompt cache lapses on an idle conversation, so the insights are harvested at a cache read (about 0.1x) instead of a cold re-read (1x plus a 1.25-2x re-cache). Needs at least minTurns of your own turns since the last close; capped per session per day. Submits a slash command by default; mode notify only notifies, mode off does nothing.

mode.title: Warm close mode
mode.description: Type exactly one of: submit (default): shortly before the cache lapses, notify and run /close conversation --checkpoint. notify: only the notification, nothing is run. off: nothing. Any other value counts as off (no picker on purpose: a picker would turn a typo into the default, submit).

ttlMinutes.title: Prompt-cache TTL (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: Set this to your account's actual prompt-cache lifetime in minutes. The default assumes 60; some plans, and usage overage, run 5. The close fires at ttlMinutes minus marginMinutes after the last turn.

marginMinutes.title: Margin before the TTL (minutes)
marginMinutes.description: Fire this many minutes before the cache lapses. Clamped to 1 through ttlMinutes minus 1.

minTurns.title: Minimum turns of yours
minTurns.description: Turns you typed since the last close that are needed before an idle close fires (at least 1).

maxPerDay.title: Closes per session per day
maxPerDay.description: The most automatic closes (or notifications) one session gets per local day. 0 means none.

childHoldMinutes.title: Hold while a child session runs (minutes)
childHoldMinutes.description: After this conversation starts a child session (start_session that really starts one) or messages one (SendMessage to a local_ id), the idle close is held for this many minutes or until the child reports; typing does not end the hold. 0 turns the hold off; clamped to 0 through 1440. A value shorter than ttlMinutes minus marginMinutes expires before the close would fire, so it is effectively off.
